items.titleEn: Five Gunners called up to England squad
items.summaryEn: Five members of our men’s first time have been named in Thomas Tuchel’s squad for the upcoming international break.
bodyEn: Five members of our men’s first time have been named in Thomas Tuchel’s squad for the upcoming international break.
Ben White, Ezri Konsa, Myles Lewis-Skelly, Declan Rice, and Eberechi Eze have all got the nod to represent England in November.
The Three Lions host Croatia at 7.45pm on Thursday, November 12 at Wembley Stadium in the UEFA Nations League, before travelling to Spain for a 7.45pm kick-off on Sunday, November 15.
England are currently second in the group with three wins from four matches, while Spain are top on maximum points and Croatia sit third with one win and three defeats.
The quarter-finals will then take place in March, followed by the semi-finals and final in June.
Konsa has made 30 appearances for England since his debut in 2024, while Lewis-Skelly has earned 10 international caps under Tuchel.
Rice has 80 England games under his belt, White has six and Eze is on 25.

items.titleZh: 五名阿森纳球员入选英格兰代表队
items.summaryZh: 共有五名阿森纳一线队球员入选了最新一期英格兰代表队大名单。
bodyZh: 共有五名阿森纳一线队球员入选了图赫尔执教的英格兰代表队，将参加即将到来的国际比赛日。
本·怀特、埃兹里·孔萨、迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利、德克兰·赖斯和埃贝雷奇·埃泽均成功入选，将代表英格兰队出战11月份的比赛。
三狮军团将于11月12日星期四晚7点45分在温布利球场进行的欧洲国家联赛中主场迎战克罗地亚，随后于11月15日星期日晚7点45分客场对阵西班牙。
英格兰目前在小组中以四战三胜的战绩排名第二，西班牙以全胜积分离榜首，克罗地亚则以一胜三负位列第三。
四分之一决赛将于3月举行，半决赛和决赛则定于6月进行。
孔萨自2024年完成国家队首秀以来已为英格兰出场30次，而刘易斯-斯凯利在图赫尔麾下已获得10次国际比赛出场机会。
赖斯已代表英格兰出场80次，怀特出场6次，埃泽则为25次。

items.titleEn: Classic WSL goals against Liverpool
items.summaryEn: Relive some of our finest strikes against the Reds before we head to Anfield
bodyEn: Our Gunners travel to Anfield to face Liverpool on Sunday afternoon (12pm UK), so why not look back on some of our finest strikes against the Reds in recent WSL seasons?

Last season saw us complete a league double over Liverpool. Stina Blackstenius netted a dramatic winner at Emirates Stadium to secure a 2-1 victory, before we thrashed the Reds 3-0 at Anfield on the final day of the season.
We come into Sunday's game two points ahead of our opponents, looking to secure a win that could move us up to fourth in the league table.

Press play on the video at the top of the article to watch stunning strikes from current stars such as Mariona Caldentey and Alessia Russo, and goals form years gone by from the likes of Jordan Nobbs and Vivianne Miedema.

items.titleEn: Match of the Week: Ten-goal epic downs Newcastle
items.summaryEn: All the twists and turns from our 7-3 win against Newcastle in December 2012 at Emirates Stadium
bodyEn: Every week, we'll look back at a classic fixture from our past and give you the chance to watch it all over again. This week, we're going back to December 29, 2012 when we faced Newcastle United at Emirates Stadium.
Following the cancellation of our Boxing Day match against West Ham United, our final festive fixture of 2012 saw us end the year by hosting Newcastle United at Emirates Stadium.
With the game locked at 1-1 going into the break, few would have predicted what would unfold in the second half as the N5 faithful were treated to a Christmas cracker!
SETTING THE SCENE
By matchweek 15, a home defeat to Swansea City had left Arsene Wenger's men in 10th spot and adrift in the battle for Champions League football next season.

But as we ticked into December, our fortunes changed, winning three on the bounce against West Bromwich Albion, Wigan Athletic and Reading. That meant we were back in the top five by the time Newcastle came to visit north London.
As for the Geordies, after an incredible 2011/12 season in which Alan Pardew had guided them to fifth place, things weren't flowing in 2012/13.
Newcastle rocked up to Emirates Stadium having lost seven of their last nine league matches, including a 4-3 thriller at Old Trafford on Boxing Day.
THE LINE-UPS
Mikel Arteta's penalty settled our previous win against Wigan, and Arsene Wenger named 10 of the 11 who started at the DW Stadium, with Laurent Koscielny coming in for Per Mertesacker at the back.

As for Newcastle, Vernon Anita and Mike Williamson dropped out of the team that played on December 26, with Gabriel Obertan and Cheick Tiote coming in. James Perch filled in at the back for Williamson in a defensive reshuffle.
Arsenal: Wojciech Szczesny, Bacary Sagna, Laurent Koscielny, Thomas Vermaelen, Kieran Gibbs, Mikel Arteta, Jack Wilshere, Lukas Podolski, Santi Cazorla, Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain, Theo Walcott
Substitutes: Vito Mannone, Johan Djourou, Francis, Coquelin, Tomas Rosicky, Aaron Ramsey, Gervinho, Olivier Giroud
Newcastle United: Tim Krul, James Perch, Danny Simpson, Fabricio Coloccini, Davide Santon, Sylvain Marveaux, Cheick Tiote, Gael Bigirimana, Gabriel Obertan, Papiss Cisse, Demba Ba
Substitutes: Steve Harper, Shola Ameobi, Sammy Ameobi, Shane Ferguson, Remie Streete, Mehdi Abeid, James Tavernier
HOW THE TABLE LOOKED
UK NUMBER ONE
The Justice Collective's 'He Ain't Heavy, He's My Brother' topped the charts at Christmas 2012.

A cover of the original released in 1969 by Kelly Gordon, the song was recorded by musicians and celebrities going under the name The Justice Collective for various charities associated with the 1989 Hillsborough disaster.
The song beat X-Factor winner James Arthur's song 'Impossible' to top spot.
After watching this classic, check out our previous Match of the Week, when we picked up our first-ever Premier League victory against Liverpool in 1992.

items.titleZh: 每周比赛：十球大战击败纽卡斯尔
items.summaryZh: 回顾2012年12月我们在酋长球场7比3击败纽卡斯尔的精彩比赛。
bodyZh: 每周，我们都会回顾一场队史经典比赛，并让你有机会再次观看全场。本周，我们将回到2012年12月29日，当时我们在酋长球场对阵纽卡斯尔联。
由于我们对阵西汉姆联的节礼日比赛被取消，我们2012年的最后一场节日赛程是在酋长球场迎战纽卡斯尔联，以此为这一年收官。
随着比赛以1比1的比分进入中场休息，很少有人能预料到下半场会发生什么，现场球迷欣赏到了一场精彩绝伦的进球大战！
赛事背景
到了第15轮，主场输给斯旺西让温格的球队跌至第10位，在下赛季欧冠资格的争夺中落后。
但进入12月后，我们的运气发生了转变，先后战胜了西布朗、维冈竞技和雷丁，取得三连胜。这意味着当纽卡斯尔来访北伦敦时，我们已经重返前五。
至于喜鹊军团，在阿兰·帕杜率领他们获得2011/12赛季第五名的惊艳表现后，他们在2012/13赛季却并不顺利。
纽卡斯尔来到酋长球场时，在最近九场联赛中输了七场，其中包括在节礼日于老特拉福德进行的4比3惊险失利。
双方首发
米克尔·阿尔特塔的点球决定了我们之前对阵维冈的胜利，温格派出了在DW球场首发的11人中的10人，洛朗·科斯切尔尼顶替了后防线上的佩尔·默特萨克。
至于纽卡斯尔，弗农·阿尼塔和迈克·威廉姆森落选了12月26日出场的阵容，加布里埃尔·奥贝坦和谢赫·蒂奥特入替。詹姆斯·佩奇在防线重组中顶替了威廉姆森。
阿森纳：什琴斯尼、萨尼亚、科斯切尔尼、维尔马伦、吉布斯、阿尔特塔、威尔谢尔、波多尔斯基、卡索拉、张伯伦、沃尔科特
替补：曼诺内、朱鲁、科克兰、罗西基、拉姆塞、热尔维尼奥、吉鲁
纽卡斯尔联：克鲁尔、佩奇、辛普森、科洛奇尼、桑顿、马尔沃、蒂奥特、比吉里马纳、奥贝坦、西塞、登巴巴
替补：哈珀、肖拉·阿梅奥比、萨米·阿梅奥比、弗格森、斯特里特、阿贝德、塔维尼尔
当时积分榜形势
英国单曲榜冠军
The Justice Collective的单曲《He Ain't Heavy, He's My Brother》在2012年圣诞节期间登顶排行榜。
这首歌是凯利·戈登于1969年发行的原曲的翻唱版本，由多位音乐人和名人以The Justice Collective的名义录制，旨在为与1989年希尔斯堡惨案相关的各种慈善机构筹集资金。
这首歌击败了X音素冠军詹姆斯·亚瑟的歌曲《Impossible》夺得榜首。
在观看完这场经典比赛后，请查看我们之前的每周比赛，我们在1992年取得了对阵利物浦的队史首场英超胜利。

items.titleEn: U18s preview: Arsenal v Sunderland
items.summaryEn: Our young Gunners battle the Black Cats for a spot in the cup knockout stages
bodyEn: Our young Gunners host Sunderland in their final U18 Premier League Cup group game, with a win guaranteeing a top-spot finish and qualification for the knock-out stage.
Kick-off at the Sobha Realty Training Centre is scheduled for 11.30am (UK time).
Josh Smith's under-18s side are on an impressive seven-game winning run across all competitions, including a 3-2 cup victory over Birmingham City last time out.
We overcame an early setback against Blues to take all three points, thanks to Abraham Owusu-Gyasi's header and two penalties converted by Jaden Maghoma.
THE OPPOSITION
The Black Cats currently top Group B, having secured back-to-back wins by beating Birmingham 2-0, before edging past Blackburn Rovers 2-1 in the North East.
Competing in the U18 Premier League North, the Mackems have registered mixed results so far and sit ninth in the table, with 10 points from eight games.
Tuesday's convincing 4-1 victory over Stoke City will boost their confidence, after heavy defeats to Liverpool and Wolverhampton Wanderers in their previous two fixtures.
The cup showdown will be our first meeting at under-18s level against the Wearside outfit, setting up a crucial test as both sides battle for a place in the next round.
HOW TO FOLLOW
The action gets underway from 11.30am (UK), with live updates available on our Academy X account and a full match report shortly after the final whistle.
Post-match, don't miss exclusive interviews with one of our academy coaches and young Gunners, as well as highlights of all the key action on The Arsenal app and Arsenal.com.

items.titleZh: U18前瞻：阿森纳对阵桑德兰
items.summaryZh: 年轻的枪手们将迎战黑猫，争夺杯赛淘汰赛席位。
bodyZh: 我们的年轻枪手将在U18英超杯小组赛的最后一场比赛中主场迎战桑德兰，一场胜利将确保他们头名晋级淘汰赛阶段。
索布哈·雷亚尔训练基地的开球时间定于英国时间上午11点30分。
乔什·史密斯率领的U18梯队在各项赛事中正处于令人印象深刻的七连胜势头中，其中包括上一场以3-2击败伯明翰城的杯赛胜利。
凭借亚伯拉罕·奥苏努-贾西的头球破门以及贾登·马霍马罚进的两粒点球，我们在对阵伯明翰城的比赛中克服了开局不利的局面，拿下了全部三分。
对手情况
黑猫目前暂居B组榜首，他们先后以2-0击败伯明翰，随后在东北部以2-1险胜布莱克本流浪者，取得了连胜。
作为U18英超北部联赛的参赛球队，这支球队目前的战绩起伏不定，在8场比赛中积10分，排名积分榜第九位。
周二以4-1大胜斯托克城的比赛将提升他们的信心，此前他们在对阵利物浦和狼队的比赛中遭遇了大比分失利。
这场杯赛对决将是我们与这支来自韦尔赛德的球队在U18级别的首次交锋，随着双方争夺下一轮的名额，这将是一场至关重要的考验。
如何关注比赛
比赛将于英国时间上午11点30分开始，我们的官方学院X账号将提供实时战报，终场哨响后不久将发布完整的比赛报告。
赛后，千万不要错过我们的一位青训教练和年轻枪手的独家采访，以及阿森纳官方应用和Arsenal.com上所有关键动作的精彩集锦。

bodyEn: Nothing better encapsulates the dysfunction that was Everton under Farhad Moshiri than the idea that an unknown vandal with a can of spray paint could influence the club’s managerial direction. “Pereira out, Lampard in” they daubed on a wall at Goodison Park when it appeared Vítor Pereira was in line to replace Rafael Benítez in 2022. Alarmed by fan protests, the Everton board opted instead for Frank Lampard and, while his tenure ended 12 months later with the club immersed in another relegation battle, there will be appreciation for the Coventry manager when he makes a first visit to Hill Dickinson Stadium on Friday. The connection between Lampard and Evertonians was genuine and a factor in keeping the club up in 2022. Both parties will be glad to see the other emerging stronger from those troubled times. Jack Grealish, meanwhile, will again be absent for Everton after his recent disciplinary breach, although the manager, David Moyes, said: “We will be working again with Jack soon.” Andy Hunter
Everton v Coventry City, Friday 8pm (all times GMT)

Back in September, when Leeds thrashed Newcastle 4-1 at Elland Road, talk of European qualification filled the West Yorkshire airwaves. Since then Daniel Farke’s side have drawn three and lost two of their ensuing Premier League games, scoring just two goals along the way. Given that their final pass has persistently let them down, optimism is turning to pessimism. Farke would call it realism. The German – who could probably do without facing Roberto De Zerbi’s improving Tottenham on Saturday – is confident his side are making progress but knows they cannot expect to run before properly mastering the art of walking. “We don’t have the individual quality [of the Premier League’s leading teams],” said Farke on Thursday. “We have to compensate by being tactically spot on and good at winning second balls. It’s not a criticism of my players, it’s reality. The dream of Europe is allowed but we know our main aim is to reach 40 points as quickly as possible.” Louise Taylor
Leeds v Tottenham, Saturday 12.30pm

Martín Zubimendi has yet to start a Premier League game this season after falling down the pecking order at Arsenal and the Spain midfielder is likely to be the subject of speculation that he could seek to depart in January. The emergence of Myles Lewis-Skelly as an alternative in the No 6 position at the end of last season has had an impact on Zubimendi after he had been a regular starter for most of his debut campaign in the Premier League. The 27-year-old signed from Real Sociedad for around £55m 15 months ago and Mikel Arteta has insisted he remains an integral part of his plans. But with the Arsenal manager trying to find the right balance in his midfield after the arrival of Bruno Guimarães, Zubimendi will be hoping he gets another chance to stake his claim against Hull on Saturday after starting in the narrow win over Slavia Prague in midweek. Ed Aarons
Arsenal v Hull City, Saturday 3pm

Álvaro Arbeloa is proof that a struggling young manager working in England for the first time can bounce back after a difficult start. Arbeloa was sliding towards the sack a month ago but he has responded at Fulham, who have taken seven points from their last three games, and will hope to extend the unbeaten run when Matthias Jaissle’s inconsistent Newcastle visit Craven Cottage. It is an inviting fixture for Fulham and a big one for Newcastle, who were poor when they lost to Everton on Monday. Jaissle, hired as Eddie Howe’s replacement in the summer, is already under pressure. But the 38-year-old could take inspiration from how Arbeloa has given himself breathing space at Fulham. Jacob Steinberg
Fulham v Newcastle, Saturday 3pm

Oliver Glasner has previous. He led Wolfsburg from mid-table to the Champions League but fell out with the club hierarchy and left in 2021. Glasner next guided Eintracht Frankfurt to Europa League glory but was openly critical of the squad’s imbalance and quality in four separate outbursts and departed in 2023. His time at Crystal Palace was a great success but after accusing the Eagles’ board in January of “abandoning” his team with the sale of Marc Guéhi to Manchester City, the Austrian left this summer for Nottingham Forest, where he became the fifth head coach in less than a year. You can probably guess where this is going. After Saturday’s defeat by Brentford left Forest 19th, Glasner was typically abrasive: “If the players buy in [to my methods], I think we can have a turnaround. And if not, the sixth manager will come in.” We’ll soon find out if Glasner has won the players around with City visiting Nottingham this weekend. If Forest’s woeful form continues, Glasner may either walk or get his marching orders from trigger-happy owner Evangelos Marinakis. Michael Butler
Nottingham Forest v Manchester City, 5.30pm

Pierre Sage pulled no punches in his assessment of Eddie Nketiah’s career after his excellent winning goal against Fulham last week in the EFL Cup. “I think his potential is higher than his performance for the moment,” said the Crystal Palace manager. “And we have to reduce this gap – because he needs it, the team needs it.” Nketiah is now 27 and won his solitary senior cap for England in 2023 after becoming the record scorer for the under-21s while he was still at Arsenal. His chances of adding to that look unlikely these days having been relegated to third-choice striker at Selhurst Park behind Jean-Philippe Mateta and Jørgen Strand Larsen. But with Mateta suspended for three matches after Palace’s appeal over his red card against Tottenham was rejected, Sunday’s meeting with Liverpool could be another chance for Nketiah to show his ability after scoring a late winner against them in Palace’s thrilling win over Arne Slot’s side last year. It has been three weeks since Brighton’s fans were savouring a famous 5-0 thrashing of arch-rivals Crystal Palace at the Amex. But the quirks of the fixture list meant that Fabian Hürzeler’s side played five successive games on the road since then, including two trips to face Manchester City. While they lost some of the momentum from the Palace victory in the defeat by Liverpool at Anfield, last week’s Premier League win over City showed they are serious contenders for the top four and perhaps even more. But Brentford’s visit to the south coast should provide a real test of those credentials as the owner, Tony Bloom, renews his rivalry with his west London counterpart Matthew Benham, who traditionally eschews his seat in the directors’ box for one in the away section. EA
Brighton v Brentford, Sunday 2pm

Eli Junior Kroupi did not take the headlines in Bournemouth’s win over Leeds but his cheeky nutmeg and sumptuous no-look pass to set up Amine Adli for the Cherries’ second goal was a reminder of why the youngster continues to be linked with a move to Arsenal, Bayern and PSG, despite being sidelined recently. Kroupi scored 13 Premier League goals last season – only Ryan Giggs, Wayne Rooney, Michael Owen and Romelu Lukaku have reached that total as teenagers – and only Erling Haaland and Will Osula enjoyed a better goal-per-game ratio in 2025-26. Kroupi’s foot injury, sustained in pre-season, has been carefully managed but after three substitute appearances in the wins over Manchester United, Aston Villa and Leeds, will Marco Rose be tempted to start Kroupi at Ipswich? Evanilson is in red hot form as the central striker but Kroupi is just as comfortable as a No 10 and surely has to play if he is fit as Bournemouth chase a seventh consecutive win in all competitions. MB
Ipswich v Bournemouth, Sunday 2pm

It is not quite six months since Sunderland beat Chelsea 2-1 at the Stadium of Light and qualified for Europe for the first time in 53 years. A day when Régis Le Bris’s side eclipsed the Club World Cup holders and Enzo Le Fée upstaged Enzo Fernández concluded with Sunderland finishing seventh. During the prolonged post-match celebrations, the captain, Granit Xhaka, grabbed a microphone and declared: “This is just the beginning – we want more.” Fast forward to gloomy November and it is not quite working out like that with even the excitement of next month’s trip to Milan overshadowed by anxiety. Sunderland are bottom of the Premier League, Le Bris concedes his side are in a relegation fight and Xhaka has looked a shadow of his former self ever since Chelsea tried and failed to sign him in the summer. Is Xhaka capable of turning back time? Sunderland securing just a second league win of the season depends on it. Louise Taylor
Sunderland v Chelsea, Sunday 2pm

Can Manchester United win two games of football on the bounce for the first time this season? Being able to pose this question sums up the state Michael Carrick and his side are in as they seek to build on Tuesday’s chaotic comeback victory over Roma. Aston Villa arrive five points better off than their hosts and are everything United are not: stable, upwardly mobile and boasting a manager in Unai Emery who consistently improves players and yields results. As the international break beckons after this last Premier League fixture of the weekend, will Carrick survive what could be an eighth loss in 15 matches? Possibly, if it is not another humiliation, but the truth may be that even United’s erratic executives do not currently know the answer. Jamie Jackson
Manchester United v Aston Villa, Sunday 4.30pm

items.titleZh: 英超周末看点：阿森纳迎战赫尔城，祖比门迪渴望证明自己
items.summaryZh: 本文盘点了本轮英超的十大看点，其中包含阿森纳对阵赫尔城以及祖比门迪的相关情况。
bodyZh: 没有什么比法哈德·莫西里时代的埃弗顿更能体现其混乱管理了，一个带着喷漆罐的未知涂鸦者居然能影响俱乐部的帅位走向。2022年，当维托·佩雷拉有望接替拉法·贝尼特斯时，古迪逊公园球场的墙上被刷上了“佩雷拉下课，兰帕德上课”。埃弗顿董事会惊慌失措于球迷的抗议，最终选择了弗兰克·兰帕德。虽然12个月后他的任期在球队再次陷入保级战时结束，但周五他首次造访希尔迪金森体育场时，仍会受到考文垂主帅应有的赞赏。兰帕德与埃弗顿球迷之间的联系是真挚的，这也是2022年球队保级成功的一个因素。双方都会高兴地看到彼此从那些艰难岁月中以更强的姿态走出。与此同时，在经历了近期的纪律处分后，杰克·格拉利什将再次缺席埃弗顿的比赛，不过主教练大卫·莫伊斯表示：“我们很快将再次与杰克合作。” 安迪·亨特
埃弗顿对阵考文垂，周五晚上8点（所有时间均为格林威治标准时间）

早在9月份利兹联在埃兰路球场4-1大胜纽卡斯尔时，西约克郡的空气中就充满了关于进球欧战资格的讨论。自那以后，丹尼尔·法尔克的球队在随后的英超比赛中取得三平两负，期间仅攻入两球。鉴于他们的最后一传屡屡掉链子，乐观情绪正在转向悲观。法尔克会称之为现实主义。这位德国教练——在周六或许本可以不用面对罗伯托·德泽尔比不断进步的热刺——坚信他的球队正在取得进步，但也明白在真正掌握步行艺术之前，他们不能指望跑步。“我们没有（英超领先球队的）个人实力，”法尔克周四说道，“我们必须通过战术完全到位和擅长争抢第二落点来进行弥补。这不是对我的球员的批评，这是现实。欧战的梦想是被允许的，但我们知道我们的主要目标是尽快达到40分。” 路易斯·泰勒
利兹联对阵热刺，周六下午12点30分

马丁·祖比门迪本赛季在阿森纳逐渐失宠，尚未在英超联赛中首发过一场比赛，这位西班牙中场很可能成为1月份寻求离队传闻的主角。上赛季末迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利在6号位上的崛起，对祖比门迪产生了影响，而在此之前，他在英超处女赛季的大部分时间里都是常规首发。这位27岁的球员在15个月前以约5500万英镑的价格从皇家社会加盟，米克尔·阿尔特塔坚信他仍然是其计划中不可或缺的一部分。但随着阿森纳主帅在布鲁诺·吉马良斯加盟后努力寻找中场平衡，祖比门迪希望在周六对阵赫尔城的比赛中获得另一个证明自己的机会，此前他在周中对阵布拉格斯拉维亚的险胜中首发出场。 埃德·阿伦斯
阿森纳对阵赫尔城，周六下午3点

阿尔瓦罗·阿韦罗亚证明了一位在英格兰首次执教的年轻主帅在经历艰难开局后能够反弹。阿韦罗亚一个月前还在下课的边缘挣扎，但在富勒姆他做出了回应，最近三场比赛取得了七分，并将希望在马蒂亚斯·贾伊斯勒状态起伏的纽卡斯尔造访克拉伦农场时延续不败战绩。对于富勒姆来说这是一个诱人的赛程，对于周一输给埃弗顿表现糟糕的纽卡斯尔来说则是一场大战。在夏天被聘为埃迪·豪接替者的贾伊斯勒已经面临压力。但这位38岁的教练可以从阿韦罗亚如何在富勒姆为自己赢得喘息空间中获得灵感。 雅各布·斯坦伯格
富勒姆对阵纽卡斯尔，周六下午3点

奥利弗·格拉斯纳有前科。他曾率领沃尔夫斯堡从中游带到欧冠，但与俱乐部高层不和并在2021年离任。格拉斯纳随后带领法兰克福夺得欧联杯冠军，但在四次不同的爆发中公开批评阵容的失衡与质量，并于2023年离任。他在水晶宫的执期非常成功，但在今年1月指责老鹰队董事会在将马克·格伊卖给曼城时“抛弃”了他的球队后，这位奥地利人今年夏天转投诺丁汉森林，成为了不到一年内的第五任主教练。你大概能猜到事情会发展成什么样。在周六输给布伦特福德导致森林队排名降至第19位之后，格拉斯纳一如既往地尖锐：“如果球员们买账（我的方法），我认为我们可以扭转局面。如果不是，第六个教练就要来了。”我们很快就会看到曼城本周末造访诺丁汉时，格拉斯纳是否赢得了球员的支持。如果森林队糟糕的状态继续下去，格拉斯纳可能会主动辞职，或者被急功近利的业主埃万杰洛斯·马里纳基斯解雇。 迈克尔·巴特勒
诺丁汉森林对阵曼城，下午5点30分

皮埃尔·萨奇在上周联赛杯对阵富勒姆的比赛中打入精彩绝杀后，对埃迪·恩凯蒂亚的职业生涯评估毫不留情。“我认为他目前的潜力高于他的表现，”水晶宫主教练说，“我们必须缩小这个差距——因为他需要，球队也需要。”恩凯蒂亚现在27岁，在效力阿森纳期间成为U21国青队的射手王后，于2023年完成了他唯一的英格兰成年国家队首秀。如今，随着他在塞尔赫斯特公园沦为让-菲利普·马特塔和约尔根·斯特兰·拉森之后的第三选择，他再次入选国家队的机会看起来不太可能。但由于马特塔因水晶宫对阵热刺红牌上诉被驳回而被禁赛三场，周日对阵利物浦的比赛可能是恩凯蒂亚展现自己能力的机会，他在去年水晶宫击败阿恩·斯洛特球队的惊险胜利中曾打入绝杀球。EA
注册加入每日足球
通过《卫报》对世界足球的视角开启您的夜晚
在通讯推广之后
水晶宫对阵利物浦，周日下午2点

距离布莱顿球迷在美洲球场品味5-0大胜死敌水晶宫的辉煌胜利已经过去三周了。但由于赛程的巧合，法比安·许策尔的球队此后连续进行了五场客场比赛，其中包括两次客场挑战曼城。虽然他们在输给利物浦的比赛中失去了一些击败水晶宫的势头，但上周在英超中击败曼城的比赛表明他们是前四名甚至更高的有力争夺者。不过布伦特福德对南海岸的造访将是对这些资格的一次真正的考验，因为老板托尼·布鲁姆将与西伦敦同行马修·本汉重燃宿敌之战，后者传统上会放弃董事包厢的座位，转而坐在客场球迷看台。EA
布莱顿对阵布伦特福德，周日下午2点

埃利·儒尼奥尔·克鲁皮在伯恩茅斯战胜利兹联的比赛中并没有抢尽风头，但他那记巧妙的穿裆过人和精妙的无视传球助攻阿明·阿德利打进樱桃军团的第二球，提醒了人们为什么这位年轻人尽管近期一直在养伤，却依然继续与阿森纳、拜仁和巴黎圣日耳曼联系在一起。克鲁皮在上赛季打入了13个英超进球——在青少年时期达到这一进球总数的只有瑞恩·吉格斯、韦恩·鲁尼、迈克尔·欧文和罗梅卢·卢卡库——在2025-26赛季中，只有埃尔林·哈兰德和威尔·奥苏拉拥有更好的场均进球比率。克鲁皮在季前赛中遭受的脚伤一直受到小心翼翼的控制，但在对阵曼联、阿斯顿维拉和利兹联的胜利中三次替补登场后，马可·罗斯会经受住让克鲁皮在伊普斯维奇首发的诱惑吗？埃瓦尼尔森作为中锋状态火热，但克鲁皮同样胜任10号位，如果他身体健康，随着伯恩茅斯在各项赛事中追逐六连胜，他肯定得登场。MB
伊普斯维奇对阵伯恩茅斯，周日下午2点

距离桑德兰在光明球场2-1击败切尔西并时隔53年首次晋级欧战还不到六个月。那是雷吉斯·勒布里斯的球队击败世俱杯冠军、恩佐·勒费伊大放异彩压倒恩佐·费尔南德斯的一天，最终桑德兰以第七名结束了赛季。在长时间的赛后庆祝活动中，队长格兰特·扎卡抢过话筒宣布：“这只是个开始——我们想要更多。”快进到阴暗的11月，事情的发展并非如此，甚至连下个月前往米兰的兴奋也被焦虑所掩盖。桑德兰目前在英超垫底，勒布里斯承认球队正陷入保级战，而自从切尔西在夏天尝试签下他未果后，扎卡看起来就像是他过去自己的一个影子。扎卡有能力时光倒流吗？桑德兰能否取得本赛季的第二场联赛胜利全在此举。 路易斯·泰勒
桑德兰对阵切尔西，周日下午2点

曼联能本赛季首次取得联赛两连胜吗？能够提出这个问题，总结了迈克尔·卡里克及其球队在他们试图延续周二对阵罗马的混乱逆转胜利时的状态。阿斯顿维拉到来时比主队多积五分，他们拥有曼联所不具备的一切：稳定、积极向上，并且拥有一个能不断提升球员并带来成果的主帅埃梅里。随着周末最后一场英超比赛结束后国际比赛日的临近，卡里克能否在可能成为15场比赛中的第8场失利中幸存下来？如果这不是又一次羞辱，那是有可能的，但事实可能是，连曼联那些反复无常的高层目前也不知道答案。 杰米·杰克逊
曼联对阵阿斯顿维拉，周日下午4点30分

items.titleEn: Donaldson proud as Gunners take part in Messi Cup
items.summaryEn: All the details from our trip to Miami for the 2026 Messi Cup as we reached the semi-finals of the plate competition
bodyEn: Under-16s head coach Michael Donaldson said he could not have been prouder of his team after a whirlwind 10-day trip to Miami for the Messi Cup.

Having been drawn against Lionel Messi's former sides Newell's Old Boys and Barcelona, as well as Brazilian outfit Palmeiras, we moved into the plate competition, where we defeated Inter Miami before losing on penalties to UE Cornella in the semi-finals.
Despite going out on spot-kicks, Michael was delighted with how our youthful squad handled the competition and can take plenty of positives from the trip.
"We've brought a really young side to this competition and the experiences that they've had will stay with them forever," Michael reflects.

"I thought they competed really well. The chance to play at Inter Miami's stadium, go toe-to-toe with some really high-quality teams that had kids older than we had out there - I think we represented Arsenal really well.

"We would've loved to have made the final and had another chance to go against Newell's, but it wasn't to be. It was amazing to see the look on the boys' faces when they're playing in a stadium like Inter Miami, going into the tunnel, standing next to their opponents, experiencing the changing rooms - it's all great learning."
While many would've been expecting sunny conditions throughout the tournament, Donaldson's team were met with downpours, flooding and waterlogged pitches.
But not even that could dampen the mood of the team as they got the chance to meet with football legend Lionel Messi in the opening ceremony.

He said: "That was brilliant and we were fortunate enough to have that opportunity at the opening ceremony. The boys went to the centre of the pitch, Lionel Messi came out, spoke to the boys and took some nice pictures. He also got to speak to the head coaches, so the staff also got the opportunity to do interviews and to meet Messi as well."
We netted two times in the group stages, both from Jaden Maghoma, as we lost out to Newells, Barca and Palmeiras. That meant we faced Inter Miami in the plate quarter-finals.

Frankie Wyatt netted the only goal of the game, with young goalkeeper Albie Shea making two big saves to help us reach the semi-finals. After going down to 10 players against Cornella, we battled hard to take the game to penalties, where we lost 4-2.
Away from the pitch, the team also enjoyed a trip to the Everglades to see some alligators as well as taking in an Inter Miami match against Cincinnati, which finished 2-2.

Reflecting on the trip as a whole, Michael said: "It was great to be able to work with so many talented kids who conducted themselves in the Arsenal way on the tour. There's a chance for probably 80% of this group to play in this competition again next year as well.
"Putting these tours together is never easy and I want to thanks the likes of Adam Tannett and Leonard Smith for all of their hard work. Hopefully we'll be back in 2027!"
items.author: Charlie Peat
items.titleZh: 唐纳森对阿森纳参加梅西杯感到骄傲
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳U16梯队赴迈阿密参加梅西杯，闯入盘赛半决赛。
bodyZh: U16主教练迈克尔·唐纳森表示，在结束了为期10天紧张的迈阿密梅西杯之旅后，他对自己的球队感到无比骄傲。
在抽签遇到莱昂内尔·梅西的前东家纽维尔老男孩和巴塞罗那，以及巴西球队帕尔梅拉斯之后，我们进入了盘赛，在击败迈阿密国际后，在半决赛中通过点球大战不敌科尔内利亚。
尽管在点球大战中出局，但迈克尔对这支年轻的阵容在比赛中的表现感到高兴，并且可以从这次旅行中收获很多积极的方面。
“我们带了一支非常年轻的球队参加这次比赛，他们所经历的经历将永远留在他们的记忆中，”迈克尔回忆道。
“我认为他们竞争得非常好。有机会在迈阿密国际的球场踢球，与一些年龄比我们大的高水平球队正面交锋——我认为我们很好地代表了阿森纳。”
“我们本希望打进决赛，再次有机会对阵纽维尔老男孩，但未能如愿。看到男孩们在迈阿密国际这样的球场踢球、走进球员通道、站在对手身旁、体验更衣室时的表情，真是太棒了——这都是很好的学习。”
虽然许多人会期待整个锦标赛期间都是阳光明媚的天气，但唐纳森的球队却遇到了倾盆大雨、洪水和积水场地的考验。
但即便如此，也没有影响全队的心情，他们在开幕式上有机会见到了足球传奇人物莱昂内尔·梅西。
他说：“那太棒了，我们很幸运能在开幕式上有这个机会。男孩们走到球场中央，梅西走出来和男孩们交谈并拍了一些漂亮的合影。他还和主教练们进行了交谈，所以教练组也有机会接受采访并见到梅西。”
我们在小组赛中攻入两球，均由贾登·马霍马打进，但我们输给了纽维尔老男孩、巴萨和帕尔梅拉斯。这意味着我们在盘赛四分之一决赛中迎战迈阿密国际。
弗兰基·怀特攻入了全场唯一进球，年轻门将阿尔比·谢伊做出两次关键扑救，帮助我们闯入半决赛。在对阵科尔内利亚被罚下一人后，我们顽强拼搏将比赛拖入点球大战，最终以4比2落败。
在球场之外，球队还游览了埃佛格莱斯沼泽公园观赏短吻鳄，并观看了迈阿密国际对阵辛辛那提的比赛，该场比赛最终以2比2战平。
回顾整个行程，迈克尔说：“能与这么多才华横溢的孩子们一起工作，他们在巡回赛中以阿森纳的方式表现自己，这真是太棒了。这支球队中大约有80%的球员明年还有机会再次参加这项比赛。”
“把这些巡回赛组织起来绝非易事，我要感谢亚当·坦内特和伦纳德··史密斯等人的辛勤工作。希望我们能在2027年重返这里！”

items.titleEn: Renée: “Every moment is defining”
items.summaryEn: Renée Slegers discusses the upcoming period of fixtures, saying every moment is defining for our season
bodyEn: Our women’s team are entering a busy period of big games, starting with Sunday’s trip to Anfield to take on Liverpool in the Women’s Super League.

That will be followed by a return to UEFA Women’s Champions League action against Barcelona at Camp Nou, before we’re back at Emirates Stadium against London City Lionesses and then Lyon at Meadow Park.
Renée Slegers was asked in her pre-match press conference on Thursday if the next four games are a defining period for our season.

“I think everything is defining,” she replied. “It was at the start of the season and it's even more so now. So every moment we have is important for us and for where we want to end up, results, how we want to present ourselves, how we want to make the club and the supporters proud as well. So every moment is defining, we know that.

“The run of games that are ahead of us, they're challenging and exciting games. Liverpool, we remember that game from last year, it was the last game in an Arsenal shirt for a couple of players and it was a special game for us. It was a special moment for us. We have good memories of the football that we played there.

“Everything is new now, but we'll want to take that into the game on Sunday as well, and then the run of games, there's of course two big Champions League games coming up. We're in a good position in the league phase, now of course facing Barcelona and Lyon in the next two, which we look forward to, to the big challenges, and then London City we have.”

Asked what the energy in the team has been like at the Sobha Realty Training Centre this week, our head coach continued: “To be clear, when I say energy, at the end of the day I’m responsible for the group, so it’s my responsibility and in addition, it’s the collective responsibility to create the energy. The energy is there of course, but it’s about how that expresses itself.
“There’s motivation and ambition to do better and turn this around among the staff and players, but I take full responsibility for the environment that we need to create.

“I can only say we’ve been very specific with the type of actions we need to generate energy for us, but the players have been really engaged, speaking up a lot, and we’ve had two or three sessions where the energy has been really good.”

Liverpool go into this game 11th in the table during a disappointing run of form, but Gareth Taylor’s side do have the fifth best attacking record in the division with 13 goals scored in eight matches.
One reporter wanted to find out what had impressed Slegers most about Liverpool this season.

“I think they had a really good second half of the season last year as well,” she added. “The game that we played there at Anfield last year, the first half, they were really brave and aggressive in their press. I think that's something they do well.

“They're very structured with their in-possession, out-of-possession way they play. I think they've added some players to their squad as well. It looks really well balanced and I think they make it difficult for teams. And they will try to do that on Sunday as well, which we'll have to break down.”

items.titleZh: 雷娜：每个时刻都至关重要
items.summaryZh: 雷娜·斯勒格斯表示，接下来的赛程对球队本赛季至关重要。
bodyZh: 我们的女足即将迎来一段密集的大战期，首先是周日客场对阵利物浦的女子英超联赛。
此后，球队将前往诺坎普球场参加对阵巴塞罗那的欧洲女子冠军联赛，随后回到酋长球场对阵伦敦城雌狮，接着在梅多公园球场迎战里昂。
雷娜·斯勒格斯在周四的赛前新闻发布会上被问及接下来的四场比赛是否是本赛季的决定性时期。
她回答说：“我认为一切都至关重要。赛季初是这样，现在更是如此。因此，我们拥有的每一个时刻对于我们以及我们最终的目标、比赛结果、我们希望如何展现自己、如何让俱乐部和球迷感到骄傲都非常重要。所以每一个时刻都是决定性的，我们深知这一点。”
“摆在我们面前的这波赛程充满挑战又令人兴奋。对阵利物浦，我们还记得去年的那场比赛，那是几名球员最后一次身披阿森纳战袍，对我们来说是一场特殊的比赛，也是一个特殊的时刻。我们对在那里踢出的足球有着美好的回忆。”
“现在一切都是崭新的，但我们也希望将这种状态带到周日的比赛中，接下来还有两场重要的欧冠比赛。我们在联赛阶段处于有利位置，接下来将在接下来的两场比赛中面对巴塞罗那和里昂，我们非常期待这些巨大的挑战，然后我们还有对阵伦敦城的比赛。”
当被问及本周索布哈地产训练基地的球队能量如何时，我们的主教练继续说道：“明确地说，当我说能量时，归根结底我要对这个集体负责，所以这是我的责任，此外，营造能量也是集体的责任。能量当然是存在的，关键在于它如何表现出来。”
“教练组和球员们都有动力和雄心做得更好并扭转局面，但我对我们需要营造的环境负全部责任。”
“我只能说，我们在产生能量所需的具体行动上一直非常明确，但球员们的参与度很高，畅所欲言，我们已经进行了两到三次能量非常好的训练课。”
利物浦目前在积分榜上排名第11位，正经历一段令人失望的状态，但加雷斯·泰勒的球队在联赛中拥有第五好的进攻记录，在八场比赛中打入13球。
一名记者想了解本赛季利物浦最让斯勒格斯印象深刻的地方是什么。
她补充道：“我认为他们在上赛季的下半程也表现得非常好。去年我们在安菲尔德的那场比赛，上半场他们的高压逼抢非常勇敢且具有侵略性。我认为这是他们做得很好的地方。”
“无论是在控球还是无控球阶段，他们的踢法都非常有条理。我认为他们的阵容也补充了一些球员。这看起来非常平衡，我认为他们给其他球队制造了困难。周日他们也会试图这样做，而我们需要将其破解。”

items.titleEn: Every word of Renée’s pre-Liverpool press conference
items.summaryEn: The head coach previews our trip to Anfield in her pre-match press conference
bodyEn: Renée Slegers was back in front of the media for her pre-Liverpool press conference at the Sobha Realty Training Centre on Thursday.
She was asked to share the latest team news, provide her thoughts on Sunday's opponents at Anfield and more.
Here's everything she had to say on the following subjects...

on playing teams who have played in low blocks against us this season:When I say things externally straight after a game, I’m always very mindful that the exact same message needs to be addressed internally, which we did straight after the game with the players. This week as well, I think what’s been happening is that at the start of the season at Emirates Stadium - because we’re aware we haven’t won there this year in the WSL, which is not where we want to be - but the fact that one team gets success the way they do at Emirates has built belief into other teams, doing similar things and stopping and frustrating us. The opposition have had incredible output - Villa for example had one shot and one goal, but we were unable to break them down enough. There’s a piece of that belief building in opposition as well, and that’s a situation we have to look at ourselves and manage.

on Nikita Parris saying opponents have lost their fear at Emirates Stadium:Other teams have to speak for themselves, but when they come to Emirates Stadium, they come to stop us, so that’s a sign of fear for me - but they also see opportunities to get one or two breaks and get a goal. That’s definitely something we need and want to change going forward, because we want to win at Emirates Stadium.

on the energy of the team this week:To be clear, when I say energy, at the end of the day I’m responsible for the group, so it’s my responsibility and in addition, it’s the collective responsibility to create the energy. The energy is there of course, but it’s about how that expresses itself. There’s motivation and ambition to do better and turn this around among the staff and players, but I take full responsibility for the environment that we need to create. I can only say we’ve been very specific with the type of actions we need to generate energy for us, but the players have been really engaged, speaking up a lot, and we’ve had two or three sessions where the energy has been really good.

on how she’s dealing with our situation herself:It’s been the same where I’ve spent my time. Of course, you have to make choices and be even more mindful of those choices you make. The way I present myself, what I choose to focus on, going in there with energy and a smile even though the natural reaction is not to, because it’s difficult for us right now. We do it because we believe it’s going to generate energy like we’ve spoken about, and we love to represent Arsenal. We need to spread positive energy around each other and with the group.

on if the next four games are a defining period for us:I think everything is defining. It was at the start of the season and it's even more so now. So every moment we have is important for us and for where we want to end up, results, how we want to present ourselves, how we want to make the club and the supporters proud as well. So every moment is defining, we know that. The run of games that are ahead of us, they're challenging and exciting games. Liverpool, we remember that game from last year, it was the last game in an Arsenal shirt for a couple of players and it was a special game for us. It was a special moment for us. We have good memories of the football that we played there. Everything is new now, but we'll want to take that into the game on Sunday as well, and then the run of games, there's of course two big Champions League games coming up. We're in a good position in the league phase, now of course facing Barcelona and Lyon in the next two, which we look forward to, to the big challenges, and then London City we have. But Liverpool on Sunday.

on the pressure we feel away from home:No. There is pressure, but the pressure is different when we play at home. We're proud to play at the Emirates and play in front of the fans. I think, like I just said, those games, the way they've played out and how our position has stopped us and disrupted us at Emirates, that's been the issue. But that's not the pressure or the fact that those results have been at the Emirates. We love playing at Emirates.

on if we’ve seen the squad perform to their full potential:There's more in this team, of course. I think we've seen moments and gains. But there's more in this team, which is important for us to get out the absolute maximum of this team, and we believe that there's positive signs. For us, it's about the high-level moments that we can produce to do them consistently well and making sure that what's been and what's behind us is not affecting us too much going forward. It gives us the information we need to be able to know how to move forward. But we need to look forward, and I think we do make steps constantly. I think we've created a situation where, like I just mentioned, because of how it started and how the challenge then grew for us, where opposition then also has seen things and go in with a certain mindset into the games. But it's all about us, and I believe we are making steps and players are in form and coming together. And yeah, I'm convinced that on Sunday, you'll see a good Arsenal team.
on the latest team news:No, no changes. So same as it stands now, there's a couple of days left, but the same availability.

on if our pressing demands have changed this season:The game is constantly evolving. I think we had about 20 goal kicks against Villa. I think 18 out of 20 we managed really well. And there's one warning sign, I think, about four minutes before the goal they score. And then there's one where it breaks down. So like I said, the game is evolving. We're looking to be aggressive in moments and stopping opposition in moments as well, respecting what they have. For example, Villa with Vangsgaard and Chasity Grant, they pose that threat. But like I said, there was 18 out of 20 that we managed well. And then that one moment broke us down, and we've reviewed it. We know what to do better, differently. We have our own reflections as a staff as well. How we set things up, of course, and we move from there.
on if there’s something missing that isn’t joining the squad up:I believe what we need is there. We just have to make sure it comes out and expresses itself on the pitch, which is my job.

on if defensive issues are to do with confidence or luck:I don't believe in luck. You create your own luck. I think, like I said, the one chance that they get is a very big open chance. It goes in through a deflection and it's a goal. But yes, you create it yourself. And we have to make sure that with the game we play and the way we play and what opposition tries to do against us, is that every single moment we have to close down. So we have to be disciplined in every single moment because opposition is looking for one or two moments.

on what’s impressed her about Liverpool this season:I think they had a really good second half of the season last year as well. The game that we played there at Anfield last year, the first half, they were really brave and aggressive in their press. I think that's something they do well. They're very structured with their in-possession, out-of-possession way they play. I think they've added some players to their squad as well. It looks really well balanced and I think they make it difficult for teams. And they will try to do that on Sunday as well, which we'll have to break down.

on what we need to improve in the final third:It's taking the spaces when they're there for us. So when we can go faster and capitalise on moments when we win the ball as well? But then when we face the low block with a lot of bodies in the box, it's about, and I think this has been mentioned before here so it's nothing new, but it's about how we set up that final chance. What is the speed of play? How do we create that open situation for ourselves? How many touches do we take? Who's the player doing what for us on the pitch? And then with situations where there's a lot of bodies in the box, you're also going to have to react to, it won't always be perfect, but you're going to have to react to moments. And yes, those are the things we're looking at. So it's not one thing. We want to be, and that's been our strength as well, we want to be unpredictable and create in a variety of ways. But we've definitely looked at a couple of things that we think we need to nail in the final third against low blocks and do them consistently well.

items.titleZh: 勒妮赛后赛前新闻发布会全纪录：展望对阵利物浦
items.summaryZh: 主教练勒妮出席赛前新闻发布会，展望客场对阵利物浦的比赛并谈到球队近况。
bodyZh: 勒妮-斯勒格斯周四重返索布哈 realty 训练中心，出席了对阵利物浦的赛前新闻发布会。
她被问及最新的球队阵容消息，并分享了她对周日安菲尔德客场对手的看法等内容。
以下是她就以下主题发表的全部言论……

关于本赛季面对摆出密集防守阵型的球队：当我比赛结束后立即在外部发表言论时，我总是非常注意，完全相同的信息必须在内部进行传达，我们在赛后立即与球员们进行了沟通。本周也是如此，我认为发生的情况是，在酋长球场赛季初的时候——因为我们知道今年我们在女超联赛中还没有在那里赢过球，这不是我们想要的结果——但有一支球队在酋长球场取得了成功，这给其他球队树立了信念，让他们做类似的事情来阻止和挫败我们。对手有着出色的效率——比如维拉只有一次射门和一个进球，但我们没能打破他们的防守。这种信念也在对手心中建立起来，这是我们必须审视和应对的情况。
关于尼基塔-帕里斯（Nikita Parris）称对手在酋长球场失去了恐惧感：其他球队必须为自己说话，但当他们来到酋长球场时，他们是为了阻止我们，所以对我来说这是一种恐惧的标志——但他们也看到了获得一两次反击并取得进球的机会。这绝对是我们在未来需要也想要改变的事情，因为我们想在酋长球场赢球。
关于本周球队的能量：需要明确的是，当我谈到能量时，归根结底我对这个团队负有责任，所以这是我的责任，此外，营造能量也是集体责任。能量当然是存在的，但关键在于它如何表现出来。教练组和球员之间有着做好并扭转局面的动力和雄心，但我对我们需要创造的环境承担全部责任。我只能说，我们在产生能量所需的行动类型上非常具体，但球员们非常投入，经常发言，我们进行了两三次能量非常好的训练。
关于她自己如何应对目前的处境：我花时间的方式是一样的。当然，你必须做出选择，并对你所做出的选择更加注意。我展现自己的方式，我选择关注什么，带着能量和微笑走进去，即使自然的反应并非如此，因为我们现在很艰难。我们这样做是因为我们相信它会像我们所讨论的那样产生能量，而且我们热爱代表阿森纳。我们需要在彼此之间以及与团队一起传播正能量。

关于接下来四场比赛是否具有决定性意义：我认为一切都是决定性的。赛季初是这样，现在更是如此。因此，我们拥有的每一刻对我们以及我们想要达到的目标、比赛结果、我们想要展现自己的方式、我们想要让俱乐部和球迷感到自豪的方式都很重要。所以每一个时刻都是决定性的，我们很清楚这一点。摆在我们面前的赛程充满挑战但也令人兴奋。利物浦，我们还记得去年那场比赛，那是几名球员身披阿森纳球衣的最后一场比赛，对我们来说是一场特殊的比赛。那是我们特别的时刻。我们在那里踢出的足球留下了美好的回忆。现在一切都是新的，但我们也希望将这种状态带到周日的比赛中，接下来还有两场重要的欧冠比赛。我们在联赛阶段处于良好位置，接下来当然要在接下来的两场比赛中面对巴塞罗那和里昂，我们非常期待这些巨大的挑战，然后我们还要对阵伦敦城。但周日是利物浦。
关于我们在客场感受到的压力：没有。有压力，但我们在主场比赛时的压力是不同的。我们为能在酋长球场比赛并在球迷面前踢球感到自豪。我认为，正如我刚才所说，那些比赛的进程以及我们的立场如何在酋长球场受到阻碍和干扰，这才是问题所在。但这并不是压力，也不是那些结果发生在酋长球场的事实。我们喜欢在酋长球场比赛。

关于我们是否看到了球队发挥出全部潜力：这支球队当然还有更多潜力。我认为我们已经看到了时刻和收益。但这支球队还有更多潜力，对我们来说，充分发挥这支球队的绝对极限非常重要，我们相信有积极的信号。对我们来说，关键在于我们能够创造出高水平的时刻，并始终如一地做好它们，确保过去已经发生的事情不会对我们的未来产生太大影响。它为我们提供了所需的信息，让我们知道如何前进。但我们需要向前看，我认为我们确实在不断进步。我认为我们已经创造了一种情况，正如我刚才所提到的，由于开始的方式以及随后对我们的挑战增加，对手也看到了情况并以某种心态进入比赛。但这一切都关乎我们自己，我相信我们正在进步，球员们状态正佳并凝聚在一起。是的，我坚信在周日，你会看到一支优秀的阿森纳球队。
关于最新的球队阵容消息：没有，没有变化。所以和现在的情况一样，还剩下几天时间，但可用人员保持不变。

关于我们本赛季的压迫要求是否发生了变化：比赛在不断演变。我认为我们在对阵维拉时大约有20次球门球。我认为20次中有18次我们处理得很好。我认为有一个警告信号是在他们进球前大约四分钟。然后有一个丢球的瞬间。所以就像我说的，比赛在演变。我们希望在某些时刻保持侵略性，并在某些时刻阻止对手，同时尊重他们的特点。例如维拉的万斯加尔（Vangsgaard）和查西蒂-格兰特（Chasity Grant），他们构成了威胁。但就像我说的，20次中有18次我们处理得很好。然后那个时刻击垮了我们，我们已经进行了复盘。我们知道该怎么做才能更好、更不同。教练组也有我们自己的反思。当然还有我们的排兵布阵，然后我们从那里继续前进。
关于是否有什么缺少的东西没有融入球队：我相信我们需要的东西都在那里。我们只需要确保它在球场上展现并表达出来，这就是我的工作。
关于防守问题是关于信心还是运气：我不相信运气。运气是自己创造的。我认为，正如我所说，他们得到的唯一机会是一个非常好的绝佳机会。球折射后进球了。但是的，这是你自己创造的。我们必须确保，通过我们的比赛、我们踢球的方式以及对手试图对我们做的事情，我们必须在每一个时刻都进行封堵。所以我们在每一个时刻都必须保持纪律性，因为对手在寻找一两个时刻。
关于本赛季利物浦令她印象深刻的地方：我认为他们在上赛季下半赛季也表现得非常好。去年我们在安菲尔德进行的比赛的上半场，他们在压迫中非常勇敢和具有侵略性。我认为这是他们做得很好的地方。他们在有球和无球的踢球方式上非常有条理。我认为他们的阵容也补充了一些球员。看起来非常平衡，我认为他们给其他球队制造了困难。周日他们也会尝试这样做，我们必须打破他们的防守。

关于我们在进攻三区需要改进的地方：当空间出现时抓住空间。所以当我们赢得球权时，我们什么时候可以更快并利用这些时刻？但当我们面对拥有大量防守球员的密集防守时，这就关乎如何创造出最后的射门机会，这在这里之前已经被提到过，所以这并不是什么新鲜事。比赛的速度是多少？我们如何为自己创造那种开阔的局面？我们触球多少次？球场上是谁在为我们做什么？然后在禁区内有很多人的情况下，你还得做出反应，情况不会总是完美的，但你必须对时刻做出反应。是的，这些就是我们正在研究的事情。所以这不是单一的事情。我们希望变得不可预测，并通过多种方式创造机会，这也是我们的优势所在。但我们确实研究了一些事情，我们认为我们需要在面对密集防守时在进攻三区将其做好，并始终如一地做好它们。

items.titleEn: The numbers behind Odegaard's 250 Arsenal matches
items.summaryEn: All the data behind Martin Odegaard's first 250 appearances as an Arsenal player
bodyEn: Martin Odegaard reached 250 Arsenal appearances in our UEFA Champions League clash against Slavia Prague.

Arriving from Real Madrid on an initial loan in January 2021 before making the deal permanent that summer, the Norwegian has led by example in that time, helping us return to the Champions League, reach the final of the competition, and lift the Premier League title for the first time since 2004.
In honour of our captain reaching the huge milestone in N5, we've taken a look at his standout numbers from his first 250 matches as a Gunner.
CAPTAIN FANTASTIC
Only three captains were younger than Martin Odegaard when he lifted the Premier League trophy in May 2026, cementing himself as a Gunners great.
John Terry in 2005 and 2006, Tim Sherwood in 1995 and Vincent Kompany in 2012 were younger than our skipper, but his impressive captaincy record doesn't stop there.

Martin captained the side for the first time against Southampton in April 2022 before becoming our permanent skipper in the summer of 2022. Since then, Martin has guided us to a top two finish in each of the past four seasons, winning the league last year.
The Norwegian has 107 wins from 164 matches in which he's started as skipper, the highest win rate of any of our captains since the start of the 1988/89 season.

Martin is just six games away from matching Patrick Vieira's number of games as Arsenal captain, but still has a way to go to reach Tony Adams, who officially became captain at the start of 1988 and skippered more than 500 matches.
CREATIVE GENIUS
Our attacking midfielder has been at the heart of our creativity since his arrival at Emirates Stadium from Spain.
Only Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes has created more chances since Martin made his debut in January 2021.

His 44 assists puts him eighth on the list of goals set up since his debut by Premier League players, with Bruno Fernandes also leading the way on 89. Bukayo Saka ranks fourth with 56 assists since January 2021.
Martin has also been exceptional at moving the attack along.

Since his first appearance, Martin has made 5287 passes into the final third, with 4271 of those being successfully completed. Only three Premier League players have provided more successful passes into the final third since 2021, showing just how influential Martin has been in the final third of play.
Martin also has 1400 passes into an opponent's penalty area across his 250 appearances, the seventh-highest among Premier League players since 2021.
TEAM PLAYER
Since his debut, only Gabriel Magalhaes (260) and Bukayo Saka (256) have made more appearances than Martin.
His number among his teammates shows he's a driving force behind our success.
Only Bukayo (132) has more goal contributions than Martin's 90 since his debut in 2021, and no Gunner has created more chances than our skipper.
After winning the Premier League, Martin has continued to lead by example as we look to build on our domestic success.

Martin ranks second in the squad on high-intensity pressures applied (252), with 143 of those coming within the opponent's half, in distance covered (95.5km) and number of sprints (96) in the first nine Premier League fixtures.
Here are his complete stats from his first 250 matches!

items.titleZh: 厄德高代表阿森纳出场250次背后的数据
items.summaryZh: 马丁·厄德高迎来阿森纳生涯前250场里程碑，各项核心数据全解析。
bodyZh: 在对阵布拉格斯拉维亚的欧冠比赛中，马丁·厄德高迎来了他代表阿森纳的第250次出场。
这位挪威中场于2021年1月从皇家马德里租借加盟，并于同年夏天正式转会。在此期间他一直用表率作用引领球队，帮助我们重返欧冠赛场、闯入欧冠决赛，并自2004年以来首次举起英超冠军奖杯。
为了致敬我们的队长在N5（北伦敦）达成这一伟大里程碑，我们盘点了他身披枪手战袍前250场比赛中的杰出数据。
梦幻队长
在2026年5月举起英超冠军奖杯时，比马丁·厄德高更年轻的队长仅有三人，这巩固了他作为枪手传奇的地位。
2005年和2006年的约翰·特里、1995年的蒂姆·舍伍德以及2012年的文森特·孔帕尼比我们的队长更年轻，但他令人瞩目的队长记录远不止于此。
马丁在2022年4月对阵南安普顿的比赛中首次担任球队队长，并在2022年夏天正式成为常任队长。自那以后，马丁带领我们在过去的四个赛季里全部跻身联赛前两名，并在去年赢得了联赛冠军。
在马丁首发担任队长的164场比赛中，这位挪威人取得了107场胜利，这是自1988/89赛季开始以来我们所有队长中最高的胜率。
马丁距离追平帕特里克·维埃拉作为阿森纳队长的场次仅差6场，但要赶上托尼·亚当斯还有一段路要走，后者于1988年初正式出任队长，带队场次超过500场。
创造力天才
自从这位进攻型中场从西班牙来到酋长球场以来，他一直是我们创造力的核心。
自从马丁在2021年1月完成首秀以来，只有曼联队长布鲁诺·费尔南德斯创造了更多机会。
他的44次助攻在英超球员自首以来的助攻榜上排名第八，布鲁诺·费尔南德斯以89次助攻领跑，布卡约·萨卡自2021年1月以来以56次助攻排名第四。
马丁在推进进攻方面同样表现卓越。
自完成首秀以来，马丁向进攻三区传球5287次，其中4271次成功完成。自2021年以来，只有三名英超球员向进攻三区成功传球次数更多，这充分证明了马丁在进攻三区的重要影响力。
在250次出场中，马丁还有1400次向对手禁区传球，在2021年以来的英超球员中排名第七位。
团队球员
自首秀以来，队中出场次数超过马丁的只有加布里埃尔·马加良斯（260场）和布卡约·萨卡（256场）。
他在队友中的出场数据表明他是我们取得成功的驱动力。
自2021年首秀以来，只有布卡约（132个）的直接参与进球数超过了马丁的90个，并且没有任何一位枪手队友创造的机会比我们的队长更多。
在赢得英超冠军后，当我们试图巩固国内赛事的成功时，马丁继续用实际行动以身作则。
在前九轮英超比赛中，马丁的高强度逼抢次数（252次，其中143次发生在对方半场）、跑动距离（95.5公里）以及冲刺次数（96次）均在队内排名第二。

items.summaryEn: ‘On us to make it better this year,’ goalkeeper admitsHe credits self-belief as key to making decisive savesDavid Raya has said Arsenal are using the pain of losing on penalties against Paris Saint-Germain in last year’s Champions League final to “make it better this year”.The Spain goalkeeper produced an outstanding save to help Arsenal hold off Slavia Prague on Wednesday as Mikel Arteta’s side moved up to third in the league standings with 10 points from four matches. bodyEn: David Raya has said Arsenal are using the pain of losing on penalties against Paris Saint-Germain in last year’s Champions League final to “make it better this year”.

The Spain goalkeeper produced an outstanding save to help Arsenal hold off Slavia Prague on Wednesday as Mikel Arteta’s side moved up to third in the league standings with 10 points from four matches.

Arsenal will face Borussia Dortmund next at home this month before hosting Real Madrid on 9 December in a showdown that could be vital to their chances of finishing in the top two and ensuring the second leg of their first knockout tie and any that follow would be at the Emirates.

That was the case last season when Arsenal became the first team to win all eight league stage matches and made it to the final in Budapest. Raya has admitted he is haunted by that experience as PSG won back-to-back titles.

“I think it is never going to be out of the system,” he said. “It is something that is going to live with us and hopefully we can win the Champions League to get that out of us. But it has to be in our veins. It has to be on us to make it better this year.”

Raya came to Arsenal’s rescue as Slavia valiantly attempted to fight back from 2-0 down at the break. His diving stop to keep out Oskar Kubiak’s header helped to make it 10 away games in Europe without defeat. Raya, who missed out on the Yashin award for best goalkeeper at the Ballon d’Or to his Spain teammate Unai Simón, credited his self-belief as key to making extraordinary saves on a regular basis.

That gives you that extra edge and motivation to keep doing it every single week, and the consistency I have been playing with throughout the years is a key factor for us.”

bodyZh: 大卫·拉亚表示，阿森纳正利用去年在欧冠决赛中点球不敌巴黎圣日耳曼的痛苦，来“争取今年做得更好”。
这位西班牙门将周三做出了一次神勇扑救，帮助阿森纳挡住了布拉格斯拉维亚的反扑，在米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队前四场比赛拿到10分后，升至联赛积分榜第三位。
阿森纳本月接下来将在主场对阵多特蒙德，随后于12月9日主场迎战皇家马德里，这场对决对于他们争取前两名、确保首场淘汰赛及后续所有淘汰赛次回合在酋长球场进行至关重要。
上赛季正是如此，当时阿森纳成为第一支赢得全部八场联赛阶段比赛并杀入布达佩斯决赛的球队。随着巴黎圣日耳曼实现卫冕，拉亚坦言那段经历一直萦绕在他心头。
他说道：“我认为这永远不会消失。这将伴随着我们，希望我们能赢得欧冠来摆脱这种感觉。但这必须融入我们的血液。我们要靠自己去争取今年做得更好。”
当布拉格斯拉维亚在上半场以0-2落后奋力反扑时，拉亚挺身而出拯救了阿森纳。他飞身扑出奥斯卡·库比亚克的头球攻门，帮助球队实现了在欧洲客场10场不败。拉亚在金球奖最佳门将雅辛奖的争夺中输给了西班牙队友乌奈·西蒙，他认为自信是自己能够经常做出非凡扑救的关键。

items.summaryEn: Another European away day, another victory for Arsenal: albeit only just. This time, Viktor Gyökeres stole the show as poor Slavia Prague matched the longest winless streak in European Cup and Champions League history despite a spirited late comeback. bodyEn: Another European away day, another victory for Arsenal: albeit only just. This time, Viktor Gyökeres stole the show as poor Slavia Prague matched the longest winless streak in European Cup and Champions League history despite a spirited late comeback. That unwanted record stands at 23, equalling the mark set by AEK Athens and FCSB – formerly known as Steaua Bucharest – while Arsenal are unbeaten in their 10 last away trips.

However, had it not been for a wonder save from David Raya, the Czech champions would have snatched a point after Wiktor Nowak pulled one back late on as Mikel Arteta’s usually watertight defence showed signs of fallibility under pressure.
In contrast to last week’s defeat against Fleetwood in the Carabao Cup, Arsenal had been cruising until the last 15 minutes after Noni Madueke fired them ahead early on, set up superbly by Gyökeres.

That was the Sweden striker’s third assist in his past five appearances, although Arteta will have been even more encouraged by the emphatic finish that appeared to put the game beyond Slavia’s reach just before the break.

But the Arsenal manager admitted his side had taken their eye off the ball by allowing their hosts back into the game with some uncharacteristic defensive lapses as Slavia racked up 18 shots to his side’s 12.

“At half-time, the message was clear: there is still a lot to do in this game,” said Arteta. “We were extremely far from our standards in everything that we have to do, in every basic, in every concept and in everything that we discussed to avoid the game that we played in the second half. That is a huge learning.”

Slavia’s solitary victory in this competition came in their first-ever match in 2007 and after losing 3-0 to Arsenal here exactly a year ago, they knew their chances of avoiding the unwanted milestone were extremely slim. Arteta’s side have developed a killer instinct on their travels in Europe – not since May 2025 in the second leg of their semi-final against Paris Saint-Germain have Arsenal lost an away game in 90 minutes.

After their exploits at Anfield on Sunday that took them three points clear at the top of the Premier League, Arteta heavily rotated his side again with six changes. It’s perhaps not surprising that Martín Zubimendi ran out of steam given the Spain World Cup winner made only his third start of a so far frustrating campaign.

For the third time in Arsenal’s past four matches, Gyökeres was entrusted with leading the line after finally getting off the mark with a scrappy strike against Fleetwood. He finished as top scorer last season with 21 goals but has clearly been struggling for form and confidence. Yet there was no doubting the quality of his assist for Madueke’s opening goal after just eight minutes.

Raya’s long ball should have been dealt with by the Slavia defence but they made the criminal error of ­allowing it to bounce. That was the cue for Gyökeres to come alive as he beat his marker to the ball, chested it down and played the perfect pass for the England forward to run on to and score. Arteta’s reaction on the touchline suggested he enjoyed it too.

Mikel Merino was Arsenal’s hero here last year with two goals and he could have extended their lead on three occasions before the half-hour mark. The lively Madueke created his best opportunity after cutting the ball back to Merino but he could not beat Nazar Domchak in Slavia’s goal.

With Martin Ødegaard watching from the bench next to William Saliba on the latter’s return from a long-term back injury, Arsenal lacked some of their usual fluency in attack. But ­Slavia were still no match for them and their task became almost ­impossible seven minutes before the break. Gyökeres exchanged a smart one-two with Merino inside the area before curling a brilliant shot into the far corner.

To their credit, the hosts began the second half with much more aggression after introducing their record signing, Ange N’Guessan, from the bench. Ezri Konsa and Declan Rice both found themselves in the book as Arsenal were pinned back. David Jurasek let fly from long range and his effort was deflected just wide of Raya’s goal. From the resulting corner, Gabriel Magalhães somehow managed to clear two goalbound headers off the line in a matter of seconds. The Brazilian celebrated with a massive fist pump but his evening wasn’t over.

Mikulas Konecny should have done much better with another header before Raya managed to push Oskar Kubiak’s header on to the post despite being at full stretch in mid-air. Slavia eventually scored the goal all their endeavour deserved in the final minute of normal time when Nowak fired in at the far post. There were a few nervous moments in stoppage time as Konecny forced Raya into another save. Arteta breathed a sigh of relief at the full-time whistle as Slavia were condemned to their fate.

bodyEn: Mikel Arteta is confident that William Saliba is ready to make his first appearance of the season for Arsenal after he played 45 minutes of a match behind closed doors last week.

The France defender started training on his own last month after the back injury he sustained at the World Cup but has since resumed full training and on Tuesday travelled with Arsenal’s squad to face Slavia Prague. It remains to be seen whether Saliba will feature in the Czech capital given such a lengthy absence, although Arteta insisted that he has no doubts the 25-year-old is primed to return.

Asked whether he would treat his comeback with caution, the Arsenal manager said: “Yes, but now you are in, or not. And now he’s in, and he’s in like anybody else. All the preparation has been done to measure all the loads and all the steps that he had to do to minimise that risk.

“Now he’s in a really good place. He’s built the capacity that we needed, and now it’s about giving him minutes. He’s a centre-back, and when that’s the case, it’s not like an attacking midfielder or a nine that you can change. A centre-back normally has to be able to play 90 minutes, and that’s why all the preparation that we’ve done to build him.”

Ezri Konsa and Gabriel Magalhães were outstanding in Arsenal’s landmark victory over Liverpool at Anfield on Sunday and Arteta admitted that Saliba’s return is likely to give him a selection headache. Konsa is also capable of playing at right-back, although he will face competition from Ben White and Jurriën Timber.

The latter escaped punishment against Liverpool when he pulled Alexander Isak’s shirt inside the penalty area and Arteta hit back at suggestions that officials could try to balance out that decision in future.

“I have a lot of clips about shirts, pulls, grabs. So I have a massive library that we can talk about,” Arteta said in an echo of his comments last month about straying outside his technical area. “We’re talking about one in particular. I have a massive library that we can throw there to remind everybody what every team is going through.”

Max Dowman is also in contention to play against Slavia as he serves a three-match domestic suspension for his red card against Fleetwood last week. He became the first 15-year-old to feature in the Champions League against the same opponents 12 months ago and could break Cesc Fàbregas’s record as the youngest Arsenal player to start in the competition.

“That’s a chapter that is gone. It’s a moment of learning from all of us, and we move on,” Arteta said of Dowman’s dismissal against Fleetwood. “He’s been engaged. Today we spent some time together, talking about things in training. He’s always super positive. When you’re 16 you have a different way of looking at things and treating things, and that’s what he brings to the team as well.”

items.summaryZh: 萨利巴伤愈随队出征，阿尔特塔称其已准备好复出。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔对威廉·萨利巴准备好迎来本赛季代表阿森纳的首次出场充满信心，此前他在上周的一场闭门比赛中踢了45分钟。
这位法国后卫在世界杯期间遭遇背部伤病后，于上个月开始单独训练，此后已恢复全队合练，并于周二随阿森纳大名单前往捷克面对布拉格斯拉维亚。鉴于缺阵时间如此之长，萨利巴是否会在捷克首都登场还有待观察，尽管阿尔特塔坚称他毫不怀疑这位25岁的球员已经做好了复出准备。
当被问及是否会谨慎对待他的复出时，阿森纳主帅说道：“是的，但现在你要么复出，要么不复出。现在他复出了，而且和其他人一样。所有的准备工作都已完成，以衡量他必须经历的所有负荷和步骤，从而将风险降至最低。”
“现在他的状态非常好。他已经建立起了我们所需的体能，现在关键是给他出场时间。他是一名中后卫，当情况如此时，它不像你可以替换的攻击型中场或9号球员。中后卫通常必须能够踢满90分钟，这就是我们为帮助他恢复而做所有准备工作的原因。”
埃兹里·孔萨和加布里埃尔·马加良斯在周日阿森纳客场战胜利物浦的里程碑式比赛中表现出色，阿尔特塔承认萨利巴的回归可能会让他面临幸福的烦恼。孔萨也能胜任右后卫，尽管他将面临本·怀特和尤里恩·廷贝尔的竞争。
后者在对阵利物浦时在禁区内拉扯亚历山大·伊萨克的球衣却逃脱了处罚，阿尔特塔对裁判可能在未来试图平衡这一判罚的说法进行了回击。
“我有很多关于球衣、拉扯和争抢的视频片段。所以我有一个庞大的资料库可以供我们讨论，”阿尔特塔回应了他上个月关于离开技术区的言论说道。“我们谈论的是其中特定的一次。我有一个庞大的资料库可以拿出来，提醒大家每个球队都在经历什么。”

items.titleEn: Andy Madley and VAR should take credit – they got major Anfield calls right | Chris Foy
items.summaryEn: Timber’s shirt pull on Isak was not a penalty on review, and Madueke’s clash with Mac Allister was clearly not violent conductThere was one incident that got everyone talking at the weekend, and that was the decision not to award Liverpool a penalty in their match against Arsenal after Alexander Isak had his shirt pulled by Jurriën Timber as he tried to get his head to a Bradley Barcola cross.The on-field decision from the referee, Andy Madley, was no penalty and it was a call backed by the video assistant referee, Stuart Attwell. bodyEn: There was one incident that got everyone talking at the weekend, and that was the decision not to award Liverpool a penalty in their match against Arsenal after Alexander Isak had his shirt pulled by Jurriën Timber as he tried to get his head to a Bradley Barcola cross.

The on-field decision from the referee, Andy Madley, was no penalty and it was a call backed by the video assistant referee, Stuart Attwell. After the match the Liverpool head coach, Andoni Iraola, said there had been a “clear, clear pull” and when the footage is slowed down or freeze‑framed, that looks to be true. But at full speed, the contact appears minimal and not sustained: Timber is using one hand and tugs briefly on the shirt, and the impact on Isak’s movement is arguable.

There is a high bar for penalising contact in the Premier League and that has to be taken into account by Attwell. Iraola said that he would encourage his players to go down in similar situations in future, but the incident was assessed by the VAR and didn’t clear the bar in his opinion on the day. For the VAR to overturn an on-field decision there needs to have been a “clear and obvious error” and that is not the case here in my view.

Later there was a great piece of refereeing from Madley that got approval from a lot of pundits, and I agree with them. The moment came in the 79th minute after a foul by Alexis Mac Allister on Martin Ødegaard. There is a coming together of a number of players and Noni Madueke squares up to Mac Allister. The pair’s heads touch with Mac Allister then falling to the ground as if seriously hurt. It’s always been the case that players look to ask a question of the referee. This was how it was when I was refereeing in the Premier League and it has not changed, with or without VAR. Here the question Madley had to answer was whether the contact by Madueke on Mac Allister added up to violent conduct. Clearly the answer to that was no. Madley gave a yellow card to Mac Allister but not to Madueke, who had been carded earlier, and the VAR did not intervene to recommend a review given there was no evidence of a missed red card. Madley deserves all the compliments he received for the way he handled it.

This was the busiest weekend of the season so far for VAR, with seven overturns across the first nine games. One intervention helps to draw a contrast with what happened, or did not happen, at Anfield, and that’s the decision to send off Jean-Philippe Mateta after VAR upgraded a yellow card to a red.

The situation followed a foul by the Crystal Palace striker early in their game against Tottenham. Mateta was trying to recover possession and tackled Micky van de Ven from behind. The Frenchman was awarded a yellow card by the referee, Michael Oliver, but when the VAR, Jarred Gillett, reviewed the footage he could see that not only was Mateta coming in from behind, he was well away from the ball and made full contact with his studs on Van de Ven’s achilles. Gillett recommended that Oliver go to the monitor to review his decision, which he did, sending Mateta off.

The VAR can initiate a review if he believes a “serious incident” has been missed by the referee. Here, Gillett was able to see what Oliver couldn’t: that Mateta’s challenge was a case of serious foul play which occurs when a player endangers the safety of an opponent or uses excessive force. The contact with Van de Ven’s achilles was clearly dangerous. It clears the high bar for intervention in a way that the pull on Isak did not. It was a good piece of work by Gillett and Oliver.

Elsewhere, VAR helped to achieve the correct outcome in a number of crucial events. An overturn in the Aston Villa v Fulham match rightly ended in Villa being awarded a penalty after the ball struck the arm of Sander Berge in an unnatural position. Chelsea were given a penalty against Manchester United after an aggressive challenge by Lisandro Martínez, who led with an arm, was initially missed on-field. Martínez was correctly handed a second yellow card, and a dismissal. At Stamford Bridge there were also two goals – one for each side – correctly overturned after they were assessed by the VAR using semi‑automated offside technology.

Coventry conceded a penalty in their 3-1 win against Sunderland after the VAR spotted a handball by Ethan Pinnock. Leeds had a goal overturned at Bournemouth after Dominic Calvert-Lewin was found to have handled the ball on its way into the net, which has to be disallowed even if accidental under the laws of the game.

That is a lot of activity at the Premier League’s VAR hub and the most notable thing was overall how quickly and smoothly it was dealt with by various sets of officials. Debate over the Isak decision may provide the main refereeing talking point before the next round of fixtures, but we should also take note when the system is working as it should.

items.titleZh: 安迪·马德利与VAR应记首功——他们在安菲尔德做出了正确的重大判罚
items.summaryZh: 专家克里斯·福伊认为安迪·马德利与VAR在安菲尔德球场的几次关键判罚准确无误。
bodyZh: 周末有一起事件成为了所有人讨论的焦点，那就是在阿森纳与利物浦的比赛中，亚历山大·伊萨克在试图接应布拉德利·巴尔科拉的传中时被尤里安·廷贝尔拉拽球衣，但裁判未判罚点球。
主裁判安迪·马德利的场上决定是不判点球，这一判罚得到了视频助理裁判斯图尔特·阿特韦尔的支持。赛后，利物浦主帅安多尼·伊劳拉表示这是一次“非常明显的拉拽”，当慢动作或定格回放时，这看起来似乎是真的。但在全速情况下，接触显得微乎其微且并不持续：廷贝尔只用了一只手短暂地拉扯了球衣，对伊萨克移动的影响是有争议的。
在英超联赛中，对身体接触的判罚标准很高，阿特韦尔必须将这一点考虑在内。伊劳拉表示他会鼓励自己的球员在未来类似情况下倒地，但在他看来，这一事件经过了VAR评估，并未达到介入的标准。对于VAR推翻场上判罚而言，需要出现“明显且清晰的错误”，但在我看来，这里并非如此。

随后，马德利做出了一次出色的裁判表现，得到了许多评论员的认可，我也赞同他们的看法。这一时刻发生在第79分钟，亚历西斯·麦卡利斯特对马丁·厄德高犯规之后。多名球员聚集在一起，农尼·马杜埃凯与麦卡利斯特对峙。两人的头部碰触，随后麦卡利斯特倒地，表现得像受了重伤一样。球员总是试图向裁判施压，无论有没有VAR，在我当年在英超执法时也是如此，情况从未改变。在这里，马德利需要回答的问题是，马杜埃凯对麦卡利斯特的接触是否构成了暴力行为。答案显然是否定的。马德利向麦卡利斯特出示了黄牌，但没有向此前已吃过牌的马杜埃凯出示黄牌，由于没有漏判红牌的证据，VAR也没有介入建议回看。马德利处理这一事件的方式赢得了所有的赞誉。
这是本赛季迄今为止VAR最忙碌的一个周末，前九场比赛中出现了七次改判。其中一次介入与安菲尔德发生或未发生的事情形成了鲜明对比，那就是在VAR将黄牌升级为红牌后，让让-菲利普·马特塔被罚下场的决定。
这一情况源于这位水晶宫前锋在对阵托特纳姆热刺比赛初期的犯规。马特塔试图重新争夺球权，从背后对米基·范德芬进行了铲球。主裁判迈克尔·奥利弗向这名法国球员出示了黄牌，但当VAR贾里德·吉利特回看录像时，他发现马特塔不仅是从背后冲撞，而且远离了球权，鞋钉完全踩到了范德芬的跟腱上。吉利特建议奥利弗去场边监视器重新查看判罚，奥利弗照做了，并将马特塔罚下。
如果VAR认为裁判漏掉了“严重事件”，他可以发起回看。在这里，吉利特看到了奥利弗没有看到的情况：马特塔的拼抢属于严重犯规，即球员危及对手安全或使用过分力量。对范德芬跟腱的接触显然是危险的。它以伊萨克被拉拽所没有的方式达到了介入的高标准。吉利特和奥利弗完成了一次出色的工作。
在其他赛场上，VAR在多次关键事件中帮助做出了正确的结果。维拉对阵富勒姆的比赛中的一次改判正确地判定维拉获得点球，因为皮球击中了桑德尔·贝格处于不自然位置的手臂。在切尔西对阵曼联的比赛中，由于利桑德罗·马丁内斯用手臂主导的侵略性拼抢在场上被漏判，切尔西获得了点球。马丁内斯被正确地出示第二张黄牌并罚下。在斯坦福桥，还有两粒进球——双方各一粒——在通过半自动越位技术进行评估后被正确取消。

bodyEn: Liverpool did not have a shot on target in their 1-0 defeat by Arsenal on Sunday, according to Opta, the first time they have drawn this type of blank in a Premier League game at Anfield since records began in 2003-04. They did not find the target in a goalless draw at the Emirates Stadium this year either, though in both games they struck the woodwork. The margins tend to be fine when recording statistical outliers.

If Alexis Mac Allister’s floated ball from distance into David Raya’s waiting arms had actually counted as a shot, would Andoni Iraola’s side have delivered a markedly better attacking performance? Far more concerning for the Spaniard will be that his team had 52 touches in the Arsenal penalty area (which is good) to create only one Opta‑defined big chance (which is bad). The Premier League average this season is five times more efficient; 10.3 box touches per big chance.

Credit to Arsenal for restricting the quality of Liverpool’s chances despite them getting repeatedly within range of their goal. Most teams have been able to do this, though. While 12 teams have had fewer touches in opposition penalty boxes than Liverpool, only Coventry with 11 have generated fewer big chances this season than Liverpool’s 12. Everton’s Thierno Barry alone has had 15, while Manchester City’s Erling Haaland has also had more than Liverpool with 14.

Liverpool have not had this issue in Europe. They have 12 big chances in the Champions League in just three games. As two of their opponents, Lask and Villarreal, are rated by Opta as being of lower standard than any side in the Premier League, this is little surprise. The relatively low stakes of a given match in the league- phase of the Champions League encourages those matches to be more open, too.

This has not been the case in the 2026-27 Premier League for Liverpool, who have spent more time building up against low defensive blocks than any other team. This is, in part, a problem of their own making as they have conceded first in five of their eight matches. Only against Ipswich and Brighton have they held two‑goal leads, meaning opponents have rarely had compelling need to significantly loosen their defensive grip.

In his first Liverpool press conference, head coach Iraola spoke of embracing the challenge set by deep-lying defences. “I prefer to face low blocks in terms of: ‘OK, we will be in control of the game, probably we will concede less chances, we will spend a lot of time in the opposition half and those are the scenarios that we have to find,’” he said. Only four teams have had more touches in the opposition half or attempted more final‑third passes than Liverpool this season, but such dominance has not led to higher value chances.

This is where Florian Wirtz should be making an impression. He has the ability to unpick the tightest of backlines. Yet he has not created a big chance in the league this season. If his low total of five in his debut campaign was understandable with the problems Liverpool faced on-and-off the pitch, he trailed distantly behind Dominik Szoboszlai (14), Mohamed Salah (11) and Cody Gakpo (10). Wirtz is frequently involved in dangerous areas, as his ranking of ninth in the division for final-third passes completed will attest. His contributions have been far more geared towards ball retention and circulation rather than incision, however.

Iraola will want Liverpool to make more productive use of their high press. Most of their big chances in the league have come via corners or open-play crosses. Bradley Barcola has had moments; he recovered possession to go clean through on goal at Brentford, before pouncing on an opposition mistake to assist Alexander Isak against Brighton. But Liverpool have produced shots from only 16.7% of their ball recoveries in the final 40 yards of the pitch, which is below average (18.4%) and the seventh-worst rate in the Premier League. Improvement here will help significantly.

Big chances account for 18.1% of shots in the Premier League this season but 59.5% of the goals. They are vitally important. Liverpool’s ambitions for Iraola’s first campaign will be severely limited unless they start fashioning them far more easily.

items.titleZh: 安德鲁·比斯利：维尔茨与利物浦在密集防守面前举步维艰
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳成功限制了对手的射门机会，利物浦在密集防守前表现挣扎。
bodyZh: 根据Opta的数据，利物浦在周日以0-1不敌阿森纳的比赛中没有一次射门命中目标，这是自2003-04赛季有记录以来，他们在安菲尔德球场的英超比赛中首次出现这种情况。他们今年在酋长球场的互交白卷中也没有找到目标，尽管这两场比赛中他们都击中了门框。在记录统计异常值时，差距往往很微小。
如果亚历Alexis Mac Allister从远距离吊射进入大卫·拉亚等待双臂怀抱的球真的算作一次射门，安多尼·伊劳拉的球队会交出明显更好的进攻表现吗？更让这位西班牙人担忧的是，他的球队在阿森纳禁区内有52次触球（这很好），却只创造了一次Opta定义的绝佳机会（这很糟糕）。本赛季英超的平均效率是这个的五倍；每创造一次绝佳机会有10.3次禁区触球。
称赞阿森纳限制了利物浦机会的质量，尽管他们多次推进到球门射程内。不过大多数球队都能做到这一点。虽然有12支球队在对手禁区的触球次数少于利物浦，但本赛季只有考文垂的11次创造的绝佳机会比利物浦的12次更少。仅埃弗顿的Thierno Barry一人就有15次，而曼城的埃尔林·哈兰德也有14次，多于利物浦。
利物浦在欧洲赛场上没有这个问题。他们在仅仅三场欧冠比赛中就创造了12次绝佳机会。由于他们的两个对手拉斯克和比利亚雷亚尔被Opta评为标准低于英超任何球队，这并不令人意外。欧冠联赛阶段比赛中相对较低的风险也鼓励这些比赛变得更开放。
对于2026-27赛季的英超联赛来说，利物浦并非如此，他们花在构建低位防守上的时间比其他任何球队都多。这在某种程度上是他们自己造成的问题，因为他们在八场比赛中有五场率先失球。只有对阵伊普斯维奇和布莱顿他们才取得两球领先，这意味着对手很少有迫切需要大幅度放松防守的时候。
在利物浦的第一次新闻发布会上，主教练伊劳拉谈到了迎接深位防守带来的挑战。“我更愿意面对低位防守，因为：‘好吧，我们将控制比赛，可能我们会丢掉更少的机会，我们将在对方半场度过很多时间，这就是我们必须找到的场景，’”他说。本赛季只有四支球队在对方半场的触球次数或尝试的进攻三区传球次数多于利物浦，但这种统治地位并没有带来更高价值的机会。

这就是弗洛里安·维尔茨应该给人留下深刻印象的地方。他有能力解开最严密的后防线。然而本赛季他在联赛中没有创造一次绝佳机会。如果他在首个赛季仅有的五次在面对利物浦场内外的种种问题时还可以理解，他远远落后于多米尼克·索博斯莱（14次）、穆罕默德·萨拉赫（11次）和科迪·加克波（10次）。正如他在进攻三区完成传球次数在联赛中排名第九所证明的那样，维尔茨经常参与到危险区域中。然而，他的贡献更多是为了控球和球权流转，而不是犀利的突破。

bodyEn: Arsenal are three points clear at the top of the Premier League table. But given the team in second are Manchester City, who are likely to be facing at the very least a major points deduction, perhaps more significant is that they are five clear of Brighton in third. The season of domination that many anticipated from the champions appears to be coming to pass.

Liverpool challenged them on Sunday. There was a 20-minute spell before half-time when they swarmed all over Arsenal, and Anfield felt at least like it did in the golden years of Jürgen Klopp, when it buzzed with an energy that could overwhelm visitors. But Arsenal got through that, reset at half-time, and navigated the second half with relative comfort. For the second league game running, they denied Liverpool a shot on target.

If there is a lesson, it is that Liverpool, like Brighton, demonstrated that a very aggressive press can unsettle Arsenal. But then, a very aggressive press can unsettle anybody. In Arsenal’s loss at Brighton, Pascal Gross and Charalampos Kostoulas took difficult opportunities; at Anfield Liverpool were denied what should surely have been a penalty when Jurriën Timber tugged Alexander Isak’s shirt – another bad moment for VAR, in that the no-call essentially mandated players to go down and highlight contact. Later, Alexis Mac Allister put a free header over. That was the difference, and this Arsenal team will not give opponents many chances. They are good at closing games out. Ezri Konsa in particular was outstanding on Sunday.

They also have a strong bench. The policy has been to make the squad deeper rather than adding the very highest quality – which is why the links with Vinícius Júnior over the summer were so unexpected. That has frustrated some, but it has been successful. Arsenal on Sunday could bring on Myles Lewis-Skelly, Piero Hincapié, Viktor Gyökeres and Mikel Merino to protect their lead with very little diminution of quality. But it’s not just on a man-to-man level that Liverpool’s options suffer by comparison; their changes upset the balance. They never really had control of the game once Dominik Szoboszlai had come on for Trey Nyoni.

It’s been a recurring feature of this season that Arsenal turn half-time draws into full-time wins – it’s already happened seven times. Winning individual games, though, is only part of it; a deeper squad means there can be more rotation, which should help prevent fatigue as the season goes on, as well as providing additional cover when injuries do occur. That said, their depth was not sufficient to get them past Fleetwood in the Carabao Cup last week, although they will face few games in conditions as challenging as those on the Lancashire coast.

There are still three-quarters of the season to go, and Arsenal were in a similarly commanding position at this stage last season, four points clear of second-placed Bournemouth after nine games. The expectation then was for a procession that didn’t materialise and looked, amid a spring wobble, to have gone awry. Then as now the feeling was not merely that Arsenal were very good, but that none of their rivals looked especially threatening.

But this season they have the memory of winning the title; the insecurity of three successive second-place finishes should be lessened. There is a resilience to them that has already brought a first win at Anfield since 2012 and a victory at Nottingham Forest after successive goalless draws at the City Ground. They’re picking up points at grounds where they’ve stumbled.

Last season, City were more resilient than had been anticipated. It may be a different story this time, and not just because of the potential for a savage points deduction. After seven straight wins they have lost successive league games to Aston Villa and Brighton, but the vulnerabilities that have been exposed had been apparent earlier in the season: a high defensive line that can be exploited. Liverpool are starting to coalesce under Andoni Iraola but they haven’t clicked quite yet and are, anyway, nine points adrift. Chelsea are a point better off but still a work in progress. Brighton have probably been the best other side, but they don’t have the depth to be considered a title challenger.

Sunday made clear what was already widely suspected: Arsenal are the best team in the league by some margin. It’s not just their depth, their cohesion and the wide variety of situations from which they can score goals, it’s that they now have belief and are picking up points at places where they have often failed in the past. And if they do build up a substantial lead by Easter, that could be hugely beneficial to their European challenge, which remains the one unconquered frontier.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳具备再次夺得英超冠军的一切条件
items.summaryZh: 周日的胜利表明阿森纳阵容更深厚、更有经验，且争冠对手实力不如上赛季。
bodyZh: 阿森纳在英超积分榜上以三分优势领跑。但考虑到排在第二位的曼城可能面临重大积分扣除，或许更重要的是他们领先第三名布莱顿五分。许多人对卫冕冠军统治赛季的预期似乎正在成为现实。
利物浦在周日对他们发起了挑战。中场休息前有二十分钟的时间，利物浦对阿森纳形成围攻之势，安菲尔德球场至少恢复了尤尔根·克洛普黄金时期的氛围，那种足以压倒客队的喧嚣能量。但阿森纳顶住了压力，在半场进行了调整，相对从容地度过了下半场。这是他们连续第二场联赛让利物浦没有射正。

如果说有什么教训的话，那就是利物浦和布莱顿一样，证明了极具侵略性的高位逼抢会给阿森纳制造麻烦。但话说回来，极具侵略性的高位逼抢会给任何人制造麻烦。在阿森纳输给布莱顿的比赛中，帕斯卡尔·格罗斯和哈拉兰博斯·科斯图拉斯抓住了困难的机会；在安菲尔德，利物浦本应获得的明显点球被漏掉了，当时尤里恩·廷贝尔拉扯了亚历山大·伊萨克的球衣——这是VAR的又一个糟糕时刻，因为没有判罚本质上等同于纵容球员倒地以突出身体接触。随后，亚历西斯·麦卡利斯特将一记无人防守的头球顶高。这就是差距，而这支阿森纳球队不会给对手太多机会。他们很擅长锁定胜局。尤其是埃兹里·孔萨在周日的表现非常出色。

他们还拥有实力强劲的替补席。球队的策略一直是加深阵容深度，而不是引进最高质量的球员——这就是为什么夏天与维尼修斯的绯闻如此令人意外的原因。这让一些人感到沮丧，但它取得了成功。阿森纳在周日可以换上迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利、皮ero·因卡皮耶、维克托·哲凯赖什和米克尔·梅里诺来保护领先优势，而实力几乎没有下降。但不仅仅是人对人的比较上利物浦的选择吃亏；他们的换人打破了平衡。自从多米尼克·索博斯莱替补上场换下特雷·尼奥尼后，他们就再也没有真正掌控过比赛。
本赛季的一个经常出现的特点是阿森纳将半场平局转化为全场胜利——这种情况已经发生了七次。然而，赢得单场比赛只是其中一部分；更深厚的阵容意味着可以进行更多轮换，这应该有助于随着赛季的深入防止疲劳，并在出现伤病时提供额外的补强。话虽如此，尽管他们将面对兰开夏郡海岸那样极具挑战性的恶劣条件，但他们的阵容深度还不足以在上周的联赛杯中击败弗利特伍德。
赛季还有四分之三的路要走，而在上赛季的这个阶段，阿森纳处于类似的统治地位，在九场比赛后领先第二名伯恩茅斯四分。当时的期望是一场没有实现的游行，并且在春季的动摇中看起来已经偏离了轨道。当时和现在一样，人们的感觉不仅是阿森纳非常优秀，而且他们的竞争对手看起来都没有什么威胁。
但这个赛季他们有了赢得冠军的记忆；连续三次获得亚军的不安全感应该会减轻。他们有一种韧性，这种韧性已经带来了自2012年以来的首场安菲尔德胜利，以及在连续两次在城市球场互交白卷后客场战胜诺丁汉森林的胜利。他们正在他们曾经跌倒过的球场上全取三分。

上赛季，曼城的韧性比预期要强。这次可能会有不同的故事，不仅仅是因为潜在的严厉扣除积分。在取得七连胜之后，他们连续输给了阿斯顿联赛对手阿斯顿维拉和布莱顿，但暴露出的漏洞在赛季早些时候就已经显现：高位防线容易被利用。利物浦在安东尼·伊劳拉的带领下开始凝聚，但他们还没有完全合拍，而且无论如何，落后九分。切尔西积分多一分，但仍然是一个半成品。布莱顿可能是另一支最好的球队，但他们没有成为争冠球队的阵容深度。

周日的比赛清楚地表明了人们早已广泛怀疑的事实：阿森纳是联赛中毫无悬念的最好球队。不仅仅是他们的阵容深度、凝聚力以及能够从各种不同情况中取得进球的多样性，还在于他们现在有了信念，并且正在他们过去经常失败的地方全取三分。如果他们在复活节前建立起实质性的领先优势，那将对他们的欧洲赛场挑战大有裨益，欧战仍然是他们尚未征服的前沿。

bodyEn: Declan Rice says Arsenal are ready for more grinding wins as he hailed the 1-0 success at Liverpool on Sunday as the performance of champions. The midfielder set up Kai Havertz for the only goal on 16 minutes but his physicality and reading of the game on the defensive side were arguably more impressive.

Liverpool were unhappy at the non-award of a penalty for a Jurriën Timber shirt-pull on Alexander Isak in the 21st minute and it was a day when the Kop fumed about Arsenal’s streetwise tactics, especially how they won free-kicks – albeit their own players were also guilty of going down too easily at times. The Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya was booked for time-wasting in the 92nd minute as his team closed out the victory.

Arsenal won 1-0 at Nottingham ­Forest in their previous Premier League away match – after which they were criticised for their lack of ­creativity. This time, the barbs centred on their gamesmanship because they were a threat on the ­counterattack. They are not about to trouble ­anybody connected to the club.

“No game is plain sailing; it is always going to be tough,” Rice said. “Looking back at that Forest game, it wasn’t the best performance but we ground it out, we won and there’s going to be more of that this season. But results like this one [at Liverpool] just make it that extra bit special so we are delighted.”

It was Arsenal’s first league ­victory at Anfield since 2012 and so far this season they have won at four grounds where they did not win when ­securing the title in the last campaign, the ­others being Villa Park, the Stadium of Light and the City Ground. “Any team who has won at Anfield in the past has never had it easy,” Rice said. “We had to dig in and give it everything because they throw so many attacks at you. We had to be resilient and strong. It was a great win.”

Asked whether it was a match in which ­Arsenal had played like ­champions, Rice replied: “For sure. It’s just drilled into us. What the manager [Mikel Arteta] has built at this club and the ­togetherness of the lads – you don’t get that ­performance without the lads being all together.

“The way the manager has ­every­thing under control, the way everyone works towards everything he wants is not like anything I’ve ever seen before. So credit to us for what we have been doing for the last few years. Now it’s a massive thing to deliver again this year.”
Dominik Szoboszlai said ­Liver­pool’s defeat demonstrated that there were only fine margins between Andoni Iraola’s side and the ­Premier League champions.

According to Opta, Liverpool failed to register a shot on target in a ­Premier League home game for the first time since records began in 2003-04, as Arsenal moved three points clear at the summit. Szoboszlai believes the contest turned on the Isak shirt‑pull incident and that there was little between the teams.

“We are just one penalty less and that’s a big difference,” the ­midfielder said. “You know Anfield, you know our quality. I know they are a great team but it wouldn’t be easy for them [to have come back from a ­successful penalty].”

Iraola claimed that he would tell ­Liverpool players to go down in the box – but Szoboszlai said that was not their style. “I don’t think in this moment you can think: ‘Oh, let me wait for someone touching me and I’ll fall down,’” he said.

“No, Alex is focusing on the ball and he wants to head the ball in the net … It’s a penalty. I don’t know what they expect from us, to dive or ­something? I don’t think we are the type of team or players to do that but from now on we might need to do it. If Alex falls down it’s a clear penalty. Timber doesn’t really care about the ball and maybe if he doesn’t pull Alex’s shirt Alex can head it in the goal.”

items.titleZh: 赖斯：阿森纳在安菲尔德的胜利展现了冠军级别的表现
items.summaryZh: 赖斯称赞阿森纳在安菲尔德取胜展现了冠军相。
bodyZh: 德克兰·赖斯表示，阿森纳已经准备好取得更多艰难的胜利，他将周日1-0战胜利物浦的比赛赞为冠军级别的表现。这位中场球员在第16分钟助攻凯·哈弗茨打入全场唯一进球，但他在防守端的身体对抗和对比赛的阅读能力可以说是更加令人印象深刻。
对于在第21分钟于尔延·廷贝尔对亚历山大·伊萨克的拉球犯规未被判罚点球，利物浦感到不满。这一天，科普看台对阿森纳的老练战术感到恼火，尤其是他们如何赢得任意球——尽管他们自己的球员有时也容易轻易倒地。阿森纳门将大卫·拉亚在第92分钟因拖延时间被黄牌警告，当时球队正锁定胜局。
阿森纳在上一个英超客场比赛中1-0战胜诺丁汉森林，当时他们因缺乏创造力而受到批评。这一次，批评的焦点集中在他们的比赛智谋上，因为他们在反击中构成了威胁。这些并不会困扰与俱乐部相关的任何人。
“没有哪场比赛是一帆风顺的，总是会很艰难，”赖斯说。“回顾对阵森林的那场比赛，虽然表现不是最好，但我们咬牙坚持了下来，赢得了比赛，这个赛季还会有更多这样的时刻。但像（在利物浦）这样的结果让胜利变得格外特别，所以我们很高兴。”
这是阿森纳自2012年以来首次在联赛中客场击败利物浦。本赛季至今，他们在上赛季夺冠时未能取胜的四个球场都拿下了胜利，其余三个分别是维拉公园球场、光明球场和城市球场。“过去任何在安菲尔德取胜的球队都绝非易事，”赖斯说。“我们必须咬紧牙关，付出一切，因为他们发起了那么多的进攻。我们需要保持韧性和强大。这是一场伟大的胜利。”
当被问及这是否是一场阿森纳踢得像冠军的比赛时，赖斯回答说：“当然。这是灌输到我们骨子里的。主教练（米克尔·阿尔特塔）在这家俱乐部建立的体系以及小伙子们之间的凝聚力——如果没有大家的齐心协力，你是踢不出这种表现的。”
“主教练把一切都掌控得井井有条，每个人都为他想要的目标而努力，这是我从未见过的。所以，我们要为过去几年所做的一切感到赞赏。现在，今年再次兑现承诺是一件大事。”
多米尼克·索博斯莱表示，利物浦的失利表明这支安多尼·伊劳拉的球队与英超冠军之间只有微小的差距。
根据Opta的数据，这是自2003-04赛季有记录以来，利物浦首次在英超主场比赛中未能产生射正，而阿森纳则将积分榜领先优势扩大到三分。索博斯莱认为比赛的转折点在于伊萨克被拉拽球衣的事件，并且两队实力在伯仲之间。

“我们只是少了一个点球，这就是巨大的差距，”这位中场球员说。“你知道安菲尔德，你知道我们的实力。我知道他们是一支伟大的球队，但（如果罚进点球）要想卷土重来对他们来说并不容易。”
伊劳拉声称他会告诉利物浦球员在禁区内倒地——但索博斯莱表示这不是他们的风格。“我不认为在这个时刻你可以想：‘哦，让我等别人碰我然后我再倒下，’”他说。
“不，亚历克斯专注于球，他想把球顶进网里……这是一个点球。我不知道他们对我们的期望是什么，是假摔还是别的什么？我不认为我们是那种会这样做的球队或球员，但从现在开始我们可能需要这么做。如果亚历克斯倒下，这就是一个明显的点球。廷贝尔根本不在乎球在哪里，也许如果他不拉亚历克斯的球衣，亚历克斯就能把球顶进球门。”
